summary: nginx returned 502 on / because default.conf proxied platform_frontend to platform-frontend:5173 while the frontend image serves nginx on port 80 inside the container (5173 is only the host-published port).
root_cause: Upstream port was taken from the host port mapping instead of the container listen port; also the compose mount path is /opt/chatbot/docker/nginx/default.conf, not /opt/chatbot/nginx/default.conf.
recovery: Changed upstream to platform-frontend:80 in both repo and /opt/chatbot/docker/nginx/default.conf, restarted nginx; root returned 200.
prevention: Document that upstreams use container-internal ports; verify each upstream with docker exec curl before publishing.
